emotional_tone: Artisanal, high-trust, friction-free, modern Soho boutique space
design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Soho urban boutique meets precision architectural venue booking
Emotion First: Warm earthy tones and tactile finishes evoke craftsmanship and vendor success
Content is King: Dynamic interactive stall floorplan with real-time slot blocking and zero ambiguity
Friction-Free Workflow: Clear multi-step wizard guiding vendors from stall selection to Stripe payment
Dense yet Breathable Admin: Executive control panel with immediate rate editing, blockouts, and reservation lifecycle management

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1C2120]
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#1C2120]

layout_and_grid.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing System: py-12 md:py-20 for sections, gap-6 md:gap-8 for grids, p-6 or p-8 for cards

key_components_to_build.name: NavigationHeader
key_components_to_build.description: Sticky blurred header with Studio Market 41 branding, live operating status indicator, nav links (About, Stalls & Pricing, Book Stall, FAQs, Admin Dashboard), and Book Now CTA button.

key_components_to_build.name: HeroSection
key_components_to_build.description: High-impact Soho style headline, key venue highlights (Central location, High foot traffic, Flexible hourly/daily/weekly rates, Plug & play setup), and interactive Quick-Start Stall Finder.

key_components_to_build.name: InteractiveStallMap
key_components_to_build.description: Visual floorplan representation of Stalls A, B, C, D and adjoining combos (A+B, C+D). Shows dimensions (e.g., 10x10 ft), included amenities, power outlets, and live availability toggles.

key_components_to_build.name: BookingWizard
key_components_to_build.description: Multi-step interactive vendor checkout: Step 1: Stall & Combo Selection; Step 2: Rental Plan & Rates (Hourly $10/hr with 4-hr min, Daily, Mon-Fri Grand Opening Special, Mon-Sun Weekly); Step 3: Date & Time Picker (Live calendar with Mon-Fri 7AM-9PM, Sat-Sun 7AM-10PM slots, blocked slot enforcement); Step 4: Vendor Profile & Requirements (Business details, category, logo upload dropzone, electrical power & furniture add-ons); Step 5: Terms & Cancellation Policy Verification; Step 6: Secure Stripe Payment simulation; Step 7: Confirmation & QR Badge.

key_components_to_build.name: AdminDashboard
key_components_to_build.description: Full admin portal to edit hourly/daily/weekly rates, update operating hours, block custom dates/time slots, toggle booth availability (maintenance modes), search/view/edit/cancel vendor reservations, and update T&C text.

key_components_to_build.name: ReservationConfirmation
key_components_to_build.description: Vibrant post-checkout receipt with unique reference code, QR code for vendor check-in, load-in instructions, print/download PDF trigger, and simulated confirmation email preview modal.

interactive_rules.stall_combo_logic: Selecting Stall A+B locks Stalls A and B. Selecting Stall C+D locks Stalls C and D. Individual stalls A, B, C, D can be selected independently unless already booked or part of an active combo booking.
interactive_rules.hourly_min_constraint: Hourly rental requires minimum 4 consecutive hours. Input validation must enforce end_time - start_time >= 4 hours during hourly mode.
interactive_rules.stripe_mock: Provide realistic Stripe Element card entry simulation with auto-fill test card option (4242 4242 4242 4242) and live total breakdown calculation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, tabs, stall cards, inputs, date pickers, admin toggles) include explicit data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, headers, or modals — use glassmorphism with backdrop blur and white/dark opacity or solid background.
Ensure hourly slot validation strictly blocks booked slots and admin-blocked dates.
Provide clear visual cues on the floorplan map when switching between single stalls and combo stalls.
Include sonner toast notifications for booking actions, admin rate updates, blockout saves, and reservation cancellations.
Keep styling responsive with mobile-first layouts so vendors can easily book on smartphone devices.
